name: transformer_loading
description: Analyzes transformer loading via cypher queries to find overloaded transformers.

requirements.description: This plugin identifies and analyzes overloaded transformers across the grid models.
agent_directives: Use this plugin when the user asks for 'overloaded transformers', 'transformer health', or 'asset utilization'.
This plugin returns a list of transformers matching loading criteria (e.g. >100%).
Allow the user to click a transformer in the report to jump to it on the map.
